content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati SRD(Direct) Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/ salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IIT Guwahati SRD(Direct) Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: SRD(Direct): M.Tech. in Signal/ Imaging Processing or Equivalent, B.Tech. in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science with National level exam like NET/ GATE with 2 yrs experience in the development of digital signal/ image processing algorithms

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: SRD(Direct): Rs. 51650.00 per month (Pay: 42000, HRA: 8400, Medical: 1250)

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Guwahati SRD(Direct) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati SRD(Direct) Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati) for a project-based research position in the Department of Electronics and Electrical Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post available under this recruitment notification is SRD(Direct) with a total of 1 vacancy allocated for the project position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the SRD(Direct) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech in Signal/Imaging Processing or B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Science qualified through national exams like GATE/NET, along with 2 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary or monthly stipend provided for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the SRD(Direct) position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 51650.00, which includes basic pay, HRA, and medical allowances.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application and selection for IIT Guwahati Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in, and candidates will be selected based on their performance in the online interview scheduled for the designated date.

faq.question: Q6. When is the scheduled date for the walk-in or online interview?
faq.answer: The online interview for the SRD(Direct) recruitment at IIT Guwahati is officially scheduled to be conducted on 05 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required to apply for this job?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification, making the application process free for all eligible and interested candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number associated with this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official advertisement number for this recruitment notification published by IIT Guwahati is 2627R-0319-EEEN1237RIDI.

faq.question: Q9. Where can candidates apply online or find the recruitment portal?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can visit the official Research & Development Cell recruitment portal of IIT Guwahati at their designated web link to apply online.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates bring for the interview process?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proofs, self-attested photocopies, and a completed application form to the interview.
